title: Closeness at home without guessing attachment

captions.energy: Explaining unknown causes through anxious accounts

meaning: Your domestic support sustains closeness when binding comfort can be discussed directly instead of an unknown response proving that rejecting an object rejects the other.
text: The Devil in the physical position of Muladhara describes actions maintaining familiar comfort even at the cost of free choice. The Moon in energy complicates them through anxious accounts of the unknown. The Lovers in emotions want open acceptance. Attachment can be defended through assumption. Both retain excess because reduction supposedly affects connection. An actual attitude remains unnamed, but maintenance continues as a way to avoid refusal or hurt beforehand although nobody has confirmed either within accessible shared conversation.

For example, a bulky object remains for rare evenings at home. One wants it removed, but the other’s brief answer seems lost willingness to spend time together. **An unclear response to an object does not explain attitudes towards closeness.** You can name present benefit and ask about the important feeling. Choice returns to both instead of acceptance indefinitely preserving a material form that an anxious guess already appointed the only possible expression of wanting togetherness.

The difficulty is caring for assumed hurt instead of discussing need. The object remains without making reciprocity clearer. Distinguishing person, object and account of a reaction offers more dependable support: each can be named separately. Support grows through actual attitudes without first guessing every hidden meaning potentially accompanying present domestic change. The response can be learned instead of protected from a conversation it has not yet entered.
